fields.name: Additional update result IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for Additional update result

fields.name: Additional update result value
fields.description: Values: 00 - no additional information, 01 - CS Fallback not preferred, 10 - SMS only, 11 - reserved

notes: The Additional update result is a type 1 information element
Bits 4 and 3 of octet 1 are spare and shall all be coded as zero
Bits 4 and 3 of octet 1 were used in earlier versions of this release of this specification
